d: The Philadelphia 76ers' stars put on an offensive clinic as Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey combined for 92 points in a dominant 135-123 victory over the Brooklyn Nets! Embiid led the way with 37 points on 13-of-22 shooting and 5 rebounds, while Jaylen Brown added 31 points, 13 rebounds, 4 assists and 3 three-pointers. Maxey chipped in with 24 points to complete the impressive scoring display. Philadelphia improves to 12-3 on the season, continuing its strong start, while Brooklyn falls to 3-10.
